text: Neurology is a discipline in clinical medicine that studies the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of diseases of the central nervous system (brain, spinal cord), peripheral nervous system and skeletal muscles. It is based on basic medical sciences such as neuroanatomy, neurophysiology and neuropathology, and combines imaging techniques (such as cranial MRI and CT), electrophysiological examinations (such as electroencephalogram and electromyography) and molecular biology techniques, focusing on exploring the causes, pathogenesis, clinical manifestations and intervention strategies of neurological diseases. Unlike psychiatry, which focuses on organic neuropathy (such as cerebral infarction and Parkinson's disease), psychiatry pays more attention to psychological and behavioral abnormalities.
